test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some cisterns are ponds.

All ponds are streets.

Some streets are cisterns.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some streets are ponds.

II. All cisterns are streets.

III. All ponds are cisterns.

IV. No street is a cistern.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and IV follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some cisterns are ponds.

All ponds are streets.

Some streets are cisterns.

The possible Venn diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba5cb4e9a3ae7815e1b967cad40977d2e824a743caa4fdb4c6af8ad7aa9750fd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some streets are ponds. - True (Because, All ponds are streets given. So, Some streets are ponds it is definite)

II. All cisterns are streets. - False (Because, Some streets are cisterns given. So, All cisterns are streets. It is not definite)

III. All ponds are cisterns. - False (Because, Some cisterns are ponds. So, All cisterns are streets. It is not definite)

IV. No street is a cistern. - False (Because, Some streets are cisterns given. So, No street is a cistern. It is not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion I follows".
